tasks.title: Basic server with CRUD operations
tasks.goal: Server runs on PORT env var, handles POST /books (create), GET /books/{id} (read), PUT /books/{id} (update), DELETE /books/{id} (delete)

tasks.title: Search and filter on GET /books
tasks.goal: GET /books supports id=, title=..., author=..., isbn=..., synopsis=..., q=... query params with case-insensitive matching and all-or-nothing filtering

tasks.title: Comprehensive error handling
tasks.goal: Return proper JSON errors (400, 404) for missing required fields, invalid JSON in PUT, unknown query parameters, and non-existent books
